decision: AUTO_RUN maiden voyage runs overnight WITHOUT the supervised trial — operator override, explicit, on the record ('option 2, accept risk, do an audit. We're liable to learn more from the failures here than if we gate early and fail continuously.')
rationale: the stranger gate already proved the current front door is lying by omission; gating early preserves a known-bad interface. Failures are allowed; invisible failures are not.

contract.budget: max 3 build slices + stranger gate rerun; 2 patch attempts per slice; mutation membrane active; halt on unclassified failure / custody ambiguity / capacity exhaustion; preserve loop.json + all receipts/transcripts; do not smooth failures into green; no scope beyond queued punch-list/front-door fixes (deviation = record + halt)
slices: 3: readme-front-door-ratchet (AG README/GETTING_STARTED against punch list; folds syntaxwarning fix per punch-list note)
contract.then: stranger gate rerun (cold codex, same protocol)
contract.exit: overnight audit doc with the 10 mandated items (changes-by-commit / punch items addressed / recurred / new failures / trilogy reached? / no-eval receipt visible? / docs agree? / §11 violations or stretches / residual risk + next slice / final loop state + exact resume point), then halt in AUDIT
